title: Internal Auditor I (2027 Early Career Program)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About Affirm’s Early Career Program
 Affirm’s Early Career Program (ECP) brings together interns and new graduates across Engineering, Business, and Risk & Analytics. You’ll do meaningful work alongside your team while becoming part of a community of peers who are learning and growing together.
 Through our structured one-year program, you’ll get dedicated onboarding, mentorship, and professional development to help support your growth and confidence. And with our hybrid-office approach, you’ll have opportunities to connect in person, collaborate with your team, and build relationships across Affirm.
 About Enterprise Risk & Internal Audit
 The Enterprise Risk & Internal Audit team protects Affirm’s operations and long-term success. We identify, assess, and monitor risk across the business. Our work includes internal audits, regulatory assurance, fraud prevention, and crisis planning. The team maintains strong controls, tracks key risk indicators, and ensures readiness for external reviews. We uphold accountability, transparency, and resilience to support responsible growth.
 About the role
 As an Internal Auditor I, you’ll support Affirm’s Internal Audit and Internal Controls teams by evaluating business processes, assessing financial reporting controls, and identifying opportunities to reduce risk. Your work will help strengthen accountability, build trust, and support Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.
 What you’ll do
 We are looking for a curious, collaborative, and detail-oriented Internal Auditor I to support Affirm’s Internal Audit and Internal Controls teams in identifying risks, strengthening controls, and helping the business operate with integrity and accountability.

The team secures efficient funding while supporting sustainable business growth. We balance cost, flexibility, and risk to ensure Affirm’s financial resilience through all economic cycles. By optimizing capital structure and managing liquidity, we help build a scalable and resilient financial platform.

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as our next Technical Account Manager on Twilio’s Personalized Support team.
 About the job
 This position is filled by a passionate engineer with customer facing experience and passion in Twilio’s Comms products, and who has a desire to support our largest and most strategic customers.
 This individual also loves helping people, solving problems, and wants to be a major factor in the success of our customers. This position is for someone who is technical, but also wants to stay close to customers. Daily, you’re likely to interact with multiple languages, web frameworks, APIs, data warehouses, SQL queries, and more. Most customer interactions happen within Zendesk, with a few phone calls, virtual in-person meetings, and Slack chats sprinkled in.

title: Sr. Counsel - Product, Engineering & AI
location: New York, NY, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 As a member of Pinterest’s Legal team, you’ll help shape the products and experiences that bring that mission to life. We’re looking for an experienced, pragmatic, and strategic product lawyer to serve as a senior legal partner to teams building Pinterest’s core consumer experience. You’ll work across the full product lifecycle and a broad portfolio of interconnected experiences—from discovery and onboarding to identity, engagement, communications, and community. You’ll help business leaders make sound decisions on complex issues, influence product direction, and build approaches that scale as our products evolve.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Ranking
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are seeking a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the technical direction of Reddit’s Core Ads Ranking and mid-funnel modeling systems. Operating as a hands-on technical leader, you will advance user representation, graph learning, and sequence modeling across ads verticals—building foundational architectures that power downstream teams including Retrieval, Shopping, Click Prediction, Video View-Through Prediction, Conversion Prediction, and App Ads Modeling.
 In addition to driving core ranking breakthroughs, you will elevate how ML engineering is executed across the org—leveraging modern AI-assisted development workflows (such as Claude, Cursor, and comparable tools) to accelerate experimentation, deepen error analysis, and raise the bar for modeling rigor and velocity.
 Why Join Us? This role offers a high-leverage technical platform to shape and scale Reddit’s foundational ads modeling and deep user-understanding roadmap. If you are passionate about solving complex ranking, calibration, and sequence modeling problems at scale—while utilizing cutting-edge AI workflows to multiply your team's modeling impact—we’d love to talk to you.
 What You’ll Do:
 Set Foundational Modeling Vision: Define and execute the technical roadmap for Core Ads Ranking, user representation, graph learning, and sequence modeling across mid-funnel objectives (clicks, video views, and conversions), balancing long-term foundational bets with measurable production gains.
